blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building upon our previous Ancilia framework, this work presents \emph{YUTELA}, an edge--server--cloud AIoT system for long-term, multi-site video anomaly detection. YUTELA replaces workstation-based on-site processing with NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge devices and redesigns the multi-camera pipeline through camera batching and redistribution, shared memory, reduced inter-stage data transfer, task integration, and TensorRT-accelerated inference. It maintains a separate anomaly model per camera, retrained on a centralized GPU server once enough recent pseudo-normal data are collected, with updated weights returned to the edge. With eight cameras, TensorRT increases throughput from 14.17 to 29.94 FPS under normal density, and the optimized edge node exceeds the throughput of the workstation-based Ancilia system in seven of nine workload settings, reaching up to 2.03 times its throughput at extreme density. This gain comes at the cost of higher latency under lighter loads with four or eight streams. YUTELA was then operated continuously for 170 hours at four public sites using 31 existing CCTV cameras. The deployment shows that runtime load is driven by scene activity and input frame rate rather than by camera count, and that retraining frequency varies by about three times across sites. The 101 automatically triggered training events occupied only about 6.6\% of a single GPU, indicating that one global node can support adaptation for tens of sites. Mean end-to-end alert latency ranged from 6.8 to 15.4~s depending on site traffic and anomaly type. These results show that YUTELA enables practical multi-camera edge processing with low-cost, camera-specific adaptation across heterogeneous sites.
blocks.zh: 基于我们之前的Ancilia框架,本作呈现出\emph{YUTELA},一个用于长期多站视频异常探测的边缘-服务器-云层AIOT系统. YUTELA用NVIDIA Jetson取代基于工作站的现场处理 通过相机分批和再分配,共享内存,减少相机间数据传输,任务集成,以及TensorRT加速推论,托尔边缘装置并重新设计多相机管道. 它每台相机维持一个单独的异常模型,一旦收集足够近的伪常态数据,更新后重量返回到边缘,就会在集中式GPU服务器上进行再训练. 有了8个相机,TensorRT在正常密度下将吞吐量从14.17个增加到29.94个FPS,最优化的边缘节点超过基于工作站的Ancilia系统在7个工作量环境下的吞吐量,在极端密度下达到吞吐量的2.03倍. 这一增益的代价是,在有4个或8个溪流的较轻负载下,耐久性较高。 之后,YUTELA在四个公共站点连续运行了170小时,使用31台现有的闭路电视相机. 部署显示运行时间负载由场景活性和输入帧率所驱动,而不是由相机计数所驱动,再培训频率因不同站点而相差相差约3倍. 101自动触发的训练活动只占据了单一GPU的约6.6\%,这表明一个全球节点可以支持数十个站点的适应. 平均端到端警报延迟度从6.8到15.4~s不等,取决于站点流量和异常类型. 这些结果表明,YUTELA能够以低成本和相机特异性的不同地点进行实用的多相机边缘处理。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The rapid growth of Internet of Things (IoT)-connected cameras has created new opportunities for intelligent video surveillance systems that can perform perception, analysis, and event detection close to where video is generated [ 1 , 2 ] . A modern surveillance pipeline may combine object detection, pedestrian tracking, pose estimation, feature extraction, and video anomaly detection (VAD) within a single system [ 3 , 4 ] . Moving such pipelines from laboratory prototypes to long-term real-world deployment, however, remains challenging. Multiple high-bandwidth video streams must be processed continuously under limited computing and memory resources, while the visual and behavioral characteristics of each deployed camera can change substantially across locations and over time.
blocks.zh: 物联网(IoT)连接的相机的迅速发展为智能视频监控系统创造了新的机会,这些系统可以进行感知,分析和事件检测,接近视频生成地点[1,2]. 现代监控管道可以将物体检测,行人跟踪,姿势估计,特征提取,视频异常检测(VAD)结合在一个单一的系统中[3,4]. 然而,将这种管道从实验室原型转向长期实际世界部署仍然是挑战。 多个高带宽的视频流必须在有限的计算和内存资源下持续处理,而每个部署的相机的视觉和行为特性则会随着地点和时间发生重大变化.

blocks.en: These challenges create two closely related requirements for practical AIoT surveillance. First, the edge-processing system must efficiently share limited computing resources across multiple cameras without introducing excessive memory use, data-transfer overhead, or processing latency [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Second, the anomaly-detection models must be able to adapt after deployment. Camera viewpoint, illumination, scene layout, pedestrian flow, and normal activity patterns can differ substantially between surveillance scenes, making it difficult for a model trained on a limited offline dataset to generalize reliably to every deployment environment [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些挑战为实际的AIOT监控提出了两个密切相关的要求. 首先,边缘处理系统必须高效地通过多个相机共享有限的计算资源,同时不引入过多的内存使用,数据传输间接费用,或处理延迟性[5,6,7]. 第二,异常探测模型必须在部署后能够适应。 相机视角、照明、场景布局、行人流动和正常活动模式在监视场景之间可能有很大差异,因此难以在有限的离线数据集上训练出一个模型,以便可靠地概括到每个部署环境[8、9、10]。

blocks.en: Our earlier Ancilia architecture established an end-to-end AIoT framework connecting surveillance cameras, local AI processing, cloud services, and user-facing applications [ 4 ] . Its real-world evaluation further demonstrated the feasibility of operating multi-stage video analytics under practical surveillance conditions [ 11 ] . However, the original architecture relied on workstation-class GPU servers for local processing and treated model training largely separately from long-term deployment. These characteristics limit its use when many independent sites require compact edge hardware and camera-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们早期的Ancilia架构建立了一个端到端的AIoT框架,连接监控摄像机,本地AI处理,云服务,以及用户造型的应用程序[4]. 其真实世界评价进一步证明了在实际监控条件下操作多阶段视频分析的可行性[11]. 然而,最初的架构依赖于工作站级GPU服务器进行本地处理,处理模型培训与长期部署基本分开. 当许多独立网站需要紧凑的边缘硬件和相机专用的改造时,这些特性限制了它的使用.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we present YUTELA , a multi-site edge–server–cloud AIoT system for efficient and adaptive real-world video anomaly detection. YUTELA moves on-site inference from workstation-class GPU servers to NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge devices and redesigns the processing pipeline around location-level resource sharing. Instead of assigning an isolated AI pipeline to every camera, streams from cameras at the same location are batched and redistributed across available inference pipelines. Shared CPU memory, reduced inter-stage data copying, combined low-latency processing stages, downstream rebatching, and TensorRT acceleration further reduce the memory and processing overhead of multi-camera inference.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出YUTELA,这是一个多地点边缘-服务器-AIOT云层系统,用于高效和适应性真实世界的视频异常探测。 YUTELA从工作站级GPU服务器转移到NVIDIA Jetson Thor 边缘设备,并围绕位置级资源共享重新设计处理管道. 由同一地点的相机产生的流水不是为每台相机分配一个孤立的AI管道,而是通过现有的推论管道进行批量和重新分配。 共享CPU内存,减少阶段间数据复制,合并低纬度处理阶段,下游阻断,TensorRT加速进一步减少多相机推论的内存和处理间接费用.

blocks.en: YUTELA also extends the deployment architecture beyond fixed anomaly inference. Each surveillance camera is treated as an individual scene with its own anomaly-detection model. Recent deployment data are continuously pseudo-labeled, and pseudo-normal samples are collected for scene-specific training. Once sufficient data have been accumulated for a camera, periodic training is triggered on a centralized GPU server. The updated model weights are then returned to the corresponding edge node, allowing each camera model to adapt to its local environment without placing the training workload on the embedded device.
blocks.zh: YUTELA还将部署架构扩展到固定异常推论之外. 每台监控摄像机都作为单个场景,带有自己的异常探测模型. 近期的部署数据不断被作伪标签,并收集伪正常的样本,用于现场特定训练. 一旦为一台相机积累了足够数据,就会在中央GPU服务器上启动定期训练. 更新后的模型重量随后返回相应的边缘节点,使每个相机模型能够适应其局部环境,而不将训练工作量放在嵌入式设备上.

blocks.en: This separation between local inference and centralized adaptation allows multiple deployment sites to share training resources while preserving independent camera-specific models. The architecture is evaluated across four real-world sites representing an urban community college, a dining and nightlife complex, a public marketplace, and a community arts center. Each deployment processes seven to eight existing CCTV streams under different frame rates, scene activity, camera viewpoints, and operating conditions, providing a practical setting for evaluating both edge efficiency and long-term scene-specific adaptation. The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这种局部推论与集中改造的分离使得多个部署地点能够共享培训资源,同时保留独立的相机专用模型. 该建筑在四个真实世界的场所进行评估,这些场所代表一个城市社区学院、一个餐饮和夜生活综合体、一个公共市场和一个社区艺术中心。 每个部署都以不同的帧率、场景活动、摄像头视角和操作条件,处理7至8条现有闭路电视流,为评价边缘效率和长期场景适应性提供了一个实际环境。 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We present YUTELA , a multi-site edge–server–cloud AIoT architecture that replaces workstation-class on-site processing with embedded edge inference (Section III ). • We introduce camera-specific adaptation triggered by accumulated pseudo-normal data volume, with centralized retraining and delivery of updated weights to the corresponding edge nodes (Section III-D ). • We optimize multi-camera inference through workload redistribution, shared-memory processing, stage integration, and TensorRT acceleration, achieving up to 2.03 × 2.03\times the workstation throughput under extreme density, with latency trade-offs at lighter loads (Section V-A ). • We evaluate YUTELA through a continuous 170-hour deployment across four public sites and 31 existing CCTV cameras, quantifying runtime performance, retraining activity, and end-to-end alert latency (Sections V-B and V-C ).

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work in AIoT video analytics, edge intelligence, and adaptive video anomaly detection. Section III presents the YUTELA architecture, edge-processing pipeline, and scene-specific adaptation workflow. Section V describes the experimental setup and multi-site real-world evaluation, followed by the discussion and conclusion.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II- 1 AIoT-Based Intelligent Video Surveillance
blocks.zh: II-1 基于AIoT的智能视频监视

blocks.en: Real-world intelligent video surveillance systems employ optical flow [ 12 ] [ 13 ] [ 14 ] , object detection, tracking, re-identification [ 15 ] [ 16 ] , pose estimation [ 17 ] [ 18 ] , action recognition [ 19 ] [ 20 ] , and anomaly detection [ 21 ] [ 22 ] algorithms to monitor activity and understand events. With recent advances in edge computing and real-time artificial intelligence, there has been a transition from running these algorithms fully on cloud to local systems closer to the network of camera sources that continuously record and transmit high volumes of visual data. Remix [ 23 ] developed a workflow for adaptive partitioning of input images that selects from a set of different neural networks on an edge device based on a latency budget. Gemel [ 24 ] , instead, merges configurations of multiple similar models on the same edge device to avoid expensive memory delays, decrease memory footprint, and improve accuracy by reducing dropped frames. DCSB [ 25 ] proposes a collaborative hybrid approach where edge object detection carries the bulk of the framework, while a discriminator decides if difficult cases should be sent to the big model on the cloud. RegionFilter [ 26 ] also implements a collaborative edge-cloud algorithm for extracting sub-segments and selecting RoIs through feedback from the cloud. While these work can be extended to handle multiple applications, they are mostly optimized and benchmarked for specific tasks rather than general context-aware surveillance.
blocks.zh: 真实世界智能视频监控系统采用光学流[12][13][14],物体检测,跟踪,重新识别[15][16],形成估计[17][18],动作识别[19][20],异常检测[21][22]等算法来监控活动和理解事件. 随着边缘计算和实时人工智能的近期进步,从完全在云上运行这些算法到更接近连续记录和传输大量视觉数据的相机源网络的局部系统已经发生了过渡. Remix [23] 开发了一个对输入图像进行适应性分割的工作流程,该工作流程从一组不同的神经网络中选择在边缘设备上,基于耐久性预算. Gemel [24] 相反,在同一边缘设备上合并了多个类似模型的配置,以避免昂贵的内存延迟,减少内存足迹,并通过减少掉帧来提高精度. DCSB [25] 提出了一种协作混合方法,边缘对象检测搭载了框架的大部分,而歧视者则决定是否应该将困难案件发送给云上大模型. RegionFilter [26] 也执行一个合作的边缘-云算法,用于通过云的反馈来提取子块和选择RoIs. 虽然这些工作可以扩展到处理多种应用,但大多是优化和基准化的特定任务,而不是一般的上下文监控.

blocks.en: II- 2 Video Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: II - 2 视频异常检测

blocks.en:
Video anomaly detection aims to detect events that deviate from normative behavior in an environment. Existing approaches adopt different representations, such as raw appearance [ 27 ] , optical flow [ 28 ] , scene graphs [ 29 ] , human skeletal poses [ 30 ] , or pretrained spatiotemporal features [ 31 ] [ 32 ] . These systems are trained either in an unsupervised, weakly-supervised [ 27 ] , or fully-supervised fashion. While these methods continue to deliver promising results and useful pretrained models leveraging diverse benchmark datasets, long-term real-world deployment and benchmarks are still limited and show degraded performance. [ 33 ] [ 8 ] [ 9 ] .
Normative behavior depends heavily on the surveillance environment, with different camera viewpoints, scene layouts, pedestrian traffic, illumination conditions, and operational patterns substantially altering the data distribution between deployment sites. [ 11 ] [ 34 ] notably noticed degraded performance of popular methods under heavy, unpredictable workloads with novel views, while [ 35 ] [ 36 ] highlight the impact of adverse weather and environmental conditions on real-world applications.
blocks.zh:
视频异常检测旨在检测环境中偏离规范行为的事件. 现有方法采用不同的表达方式,如原始外观[27],光学流[28],场景图[29],人类骨骼形成[30],或预受训练的瞬间特征[31][32]. 这些系统要么以无监督、无监督[27]或完全监督的方式培训。 虽然这些方法继续提供有希望的成果和有用的预先训练模型,利用各种基准数据集,但长期的实际世界部署和基准仍然有限,而且业绩退化。 [33] [8] [9].
规范行为严重依赖监视环境,相机视线不同,场景布局不同,行人流量,照明条件不同,操作模式大大改变了部署地点之间的数据分布. [11] [34] 特别注意到流行方法在具有新观点的繁重、无法预测的工作量下表现退化,而[35] [36] 强调不利的天气和环境条件对现实世界应用的影响。

blocks.en: II- 3 Domain Adaptation and periodic training for VAD
blocks.zh: II-3 地区适应和定期培训

blocks.en: Domain shift is a central problem for practical video anomaly detection. Models trained on one dataset or surveillance site may not retain the same performance after deployment to a new environment due to factors discussed above. Hence, Continual Learning [ 34 ] [ 37 ] [ 38 ] has been proposed as a solution to adapt models to changing benchmarks or environments, using fixed or adaptive criteria to select prominent novel data to learn from. Despite their decent performance, adaptation is performed in an offline fashion without systems-level implementation in mind. Additionally, retraining a new model from scratch for every camera or deployment site is expensive and difficult to maintain at scale.
blocks.zh: 域移是实用视频异常探测的核心问题. 由于上文讨论的因素,在一个数据集或监测站点上培训的模型在部署到新环境后可能不会保持同样的性能。 因此,有人提出继续学习[34][37][38],作为使模型适应不断变化的基准或环境的一种解决办法,使用固定或适应性标准来选择值得学习的突出的新数据。 尽管适应工作表现良好,但是在不考虑系统一级实施的情况下,以离线方式进行的。 此外,从零开始对每个照相机或部署地点进行新模式的再培训费用高昂,难以维持规模。

blocks.en:
Periodic training emerges as an attractive solution by making surveillance workflows update models as new data is collected over time, while trying to preserve previously learned knowledge [ 39 ] [ 40 ] .
However, integrating this paradigm into a distributed surveillance system poses several additional system-level questions on the choice of edge or cloud training(or both), the transfer of novel data, distributing updated weights, and the real-time inference operation as models evolve.
blocks.zh:
定期培训作为一种有吸引力的解决办法出现,它使监视工作流程随着新数据的收集而更新模型,同时努力保存以前学到的知识[39][40]。
然而,将这个范式纳入分布式监视系统,在边缘或云训练的选择(或两者),新数据的转移,更新的权重分配,以及模型演进时的实时推论操作等方面又提出了几个系统层面的问题.

blocks.en: II- 4 Summary and Research Gap
blocks.zh: 二、4 总结和研究差距

blocks.en: Existing research has advanced edge video analytics, anomaly detection, and model adaptation, but fewer studies evaluate their integration within continuously operating, multi-site surveillance systems. Building on our Ancilia framework and its field evaluation [ 4 , 11 ] , YUTELA combines resource-efficient embedded inference, shared multi-camera processing, centralized camera-specific periodic training, and cloud-based alert delivery. The focus is on implementing and evaluating this complete workflow across heterogeneous real-world sites, examining computational performance, continuous operation, retraining activity, and end-to-end alert latency.
blocks.zh: 现有的研究有先进的边缘视频分析,异常检测,以及模型改造,但较少研究评价它们在持续运行的多地点监测系统中的整合. 基于我们的Ancilia框架及其实地评价[4,11],YUTELA将资源效率高的嵌入式推论,共享多镜头处理,集中式相机专用定期训练,以及基于云的警报提供结合起来. 重点是在不同的现实世界地点执行和评价这一完整的工作流程,审查计算业绩、持续运作、再培训活动以及端到端的警示延迟。

blocks.en: III YUTELA System Architecture
blocks.zh: 三、犹太教 系统架构

blocks.en: Building upon the end-to-end surveillance framework established in our previous Ancilia system [ 4 , 11 ] , YUTELA extends the architecture toward resource-efficient multi-site deployment and long-term adaptation to scene-dependent domain shift [ 41 , 8 ] . While Ancilia demonstrated real-time video analytics using workstation-class edge servers, YUTELA redesigns the system around embedded edge computing and centralized scene-specific model adaptation. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the system consists of four interacting components: distributed edge nodes, a global node, a cloud service, and user devices. Video analysis is performed locally at each edge node, while selected deployment data are transferred to the global node for statistical analysis and periodic scene-specific anomaly training. Updated model weights are subsequently returned to the corresponding edge node for the specific scene, enabling the anomaly detector to adapt to local scene characteristics without interrupting continuous video processing. Object-level anomaly information is delivered through the cloud directly for alert generation, while the cloud also supports user interaction, requests, and feedback.
blocks.zh: 根据我们以前的安西利亚系统[4,11]建立的端到端监控框架,YUTELA将架构扩展到资源效率高的多地点部署和长期适应视景域转移[41,8]. Ancilia利用工作站级边缘服务器演示实时视频分析,YUTELA则围绕嵌入边计算和集中场景特异性模型改造重新设计系统. 如图1所示,该系统包括四个相互作用的组成部分:分布式边缘节点、一个全球节点、一个云服务以及用户设备。 视频分析在每个边缘节点在当地进行,而选定的部署数据则转移到全球节点进行统计分析和定期的场景异常训练. 更新后的模型重量随后返回特定场景的相应边缘节点,使异常探测器能够在不中断连续视频处理的情况下适应局部场景特性. 对象级异常信息通过云直接传递,用于提醒生成,而云也支持用户互动,请求,以及反馈.

blocks.en: III-A Edge Node: Real-Time Video Processing
blocks.zh: III-A边缘节点:实时视频处理

blocks.en: The edge node serves as the primary real-time inference component of YUTELA and performs video pre-processing, pedestrian and object detection, tracking, human pose estimation, and anomaly inference locally. Similar to Ancilia [ 4 ] , these algorithms are organized as a sequential processing pipeline in which the output of one stage is consumed by subsequent stages. However, YUTELA further separates the handling of object-level and behavior-level anomalies according to their response-time and analysis requirements.
blocks.zh: 边缘节点是YUTELA的主要实时推论部分,并在当地进行视频预处理、行人和物体检测、跟踪、人类姿势估计和异常推论。 与Ancilia [4]类似,这些算法被组织为一个顺序处理管道,其中一个阶段的输出被后续阶段消耗. 然而,YUTELA进一步将对象级和行为级异常的处理根据其反应时间和分析要求分开.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , detected object anomalies are forwarded directly from the edge node to the cloud. Object-level events generally require rapid notification; therefore, bypassing additional global processing reduces the communication and processing delay before the event becomes available to the user-facing application. Behavior anomalies follow a different path. The edge node accumulates scene-related feature information and the corresponding anomaly scores into batched data, denoted as D D , which are periodically transmitted to the global node. Rather than immediately treating every local anomaly score as a confirmed event, the global node performs additional statistical analysis over the collected data to reduce scene-dependent false positives. The resulting statistical analysis, denoted as S ​ A SA , is subsequently associated with the corresponding behavior anomaly information and forwarded to the cloud for event storage, notification, and user interaction. This separation allows YUTELA to maintain low response latency for explicit object anomalies while applying additional cross-sample analysis to behavior anomalies where false positive suppression is more important.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,检测到的物体异常从边缘节点直接传递到云中. 对象级事件一般需要快速通知;因此,绕过额外的全局处理会减少在事件提供给用户的应用程序之前的通讯和处理延迟. 行为异常跟随不同的路径. 边缘节点将与场景相关的特征信息以及相应的异常分数累积成批量数据,表示为D D ,定期传输到全局节点. 全球节点不是立即将每个局部异常分作为确认事件处理,而是对所收集的数据进行额外的统计分析,以减少场景依赖的假阳性. 由此产生的统计分析称为S A SA ,随后与相应的行为异常信息相关联,并转发到云中用于事件存储,通知和用户互动. 这种分离使得YUTELA能够保持对明显物体异常的低响应延迟,同时对假正抑制更重要的行为异常进行额外的交叉样本分析.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Comparison of high-accuracy reference models and the algorithmic cores of YUTELA.
blocks.zh: 表格 I:高精确度参考模型与YUTELA算法核心的比较.

blocks.en: The algorithmic core of YUTELA also evolves from that of Ancilia to better support edge device deployment and behavior anomaly analysis. As summarized in Table I , the processing pipeline consists of object detection, pedestrian tracking, pose estimation, and anomaly detection. Because the outputs of these algorithms are propagated through the pipeline, errors introduced by an upstream model can affect subsequent processing stages. The comparison with high-accuracy reference algorithms therefore provides an indication of the accuracy tradeoff introduced by selecting models that are more practical for continuous real-time execution on edge hardware.
blocks.zh: YUTELA的算法核心也从Ancilia演化为更好的支持边缘设备部署和行为异常分析. 如表一所示,处理管道包括物体探测、行人跟踪、估计和异常探测。 由于这些算法的输出通过管道传播,上游模型引入的错误会影响后续的处理阶段. 因此,与高精确度参考算法的比较,通过选择更适合在边缘硬件上持续实时执行的模型,可以表明所引入的精度权衡.

blocks.en: Compared with Ancilia, YUTELA updates the object detection and pose estimation components while retaining ByteTrack [ 48 ] for pedestrian tracking. YOLOv5 [ 47 ] and HRNet [ 49 ] are replaced by YOLO26 [ 50 ] and AlphaPose [ 18 ] , respectively, to better support deployment on the target edge platform. Rather than maximizing standalone benchmark accuracy, these models are selected to balance perception performance with the throughput, latency, and resource constraints of continuous multi-camera processing. YUTELA also introduces video anomaly detection as a major downstream task through SPARTA [ 30 ] , which operates on features generated by the preceding perception stages. The resulting anomaly scores and associated features form the behavior anomaly data D D , which is sent to the global node for further statistical analysis and scene-specific adaptation. Further details on memory-efficient and high-throughput edge inference are presented in Section III-D .
blocks.zh: 与Ancilia相比,YUTELA更新了对象检测并提出了估计组件,同时保留了ByteTrack [48]用于行人跟踪. YOLOv5 [47]和HRNet [49]分别被YOLO26 [50]和AlphaPose [18]所取代,以更好地支持目标边缘平台的部署. 选择这些模型不是为了最大限度地提高独立基准的准确性,而是要平衡感知性能与连续多相机处理的吞吐量、耐久性和资源制约。 YUTELA还引入视频异常探测,作为通过SPARTA[30]的一项主要下游任务,该任务运行于前期感知阶段产生的特性. 由此产生的异常分数和相关特征构成行为异常数据DD . . . 关于内存高效和高通量边推论的进一步详情见第三节D节。

blocks.en: III-B Global Node: Data Management and Analysis
blocks.zh: 三-B 全球节点:数据管理和分析

blocks.en: The global node provides two centralized functions for edge nodes deployed across different locations: statistical data analysis and scene-specific model adaptation. Unlike the edge node, it does not participate directly in latency-sensitive video inference. Instead, it receives selected batched data and anomaly-related information from the edge nodes to support longer-term analysis and continual adaptation.
blocks.zh: 全球节点为部署在不同地点的边缘节点提供两个集中功能:统计数据分析和场景特异性模型适应. 与边缘节点不同的是,它不直接参加耐久敏感视频推论. 相反,它从边缘节点收到选定的批量数据和与异常有关的信息,以支持较长期的分析和持续适应。

blocks.en: First, the global database collects batched data D D from all connected edge nodes. These data include anomaly features and contextual information such as deployment location, camera ID, object ID, human count, bounding-box information, and object movement. Historical records are combined with recently received data to characterize scene activity, movement patterns, and anomaly score distributions. The resulting statistical analysis S ​ A SA provides additional context for evaluating behavior anomalies and reducing false positive events before the corresponding analysis is forwarded to the cloud.
blocks.zh: 首先,全球数据库从所有连接的边缘节点收集批量数据DD. 这些数据包括异常特征和背景信息,如部署位置,相机ID,物体ID,人数,边框信息,以及物体移动. 历史记录与最近收到的数据相结合,以描述现场活动、运动模式和异常分数分布。 由此产生的统计分析S A SA为评价行为异常和减少假阳性事件提供了额外的上下文,然后将相应的分析传递给云.

blocks.en: Second, the global node communicates with the anomaly detection component of each edge node to support scene-specific adaptation under domain shift. Prior studies have demonstrated the importance of scene-dependent adaptation for real-world anomaly detection [ 41 , 8 , 51 ] . Based on newly collected data and scene statistics, scene-specific trainable data S ​ S ​ T ​ D SSTD are constructed for the corresponding deployment environment. When the adaptation criteria are satisfied, the global node performs periodic anomaly model training and generates updated model weights W ​ W WW , which are returned to the associated edge node. Further details on the periodic scene-specific training and domain adaptation process are presented in Section III-D .
blocks.zh: 第二,全局节点与每个边缘节点的异常检测组件进行通信,支持域移下的场景特定适应. 以前的研究表明,根据场景进行适应对现实世界异常探测的重要性[41、8、51]。 根据新收集的数据和场景统计,为相应的部署环境构建了针对场景的可训练数据S S T D SSTD. 当适应标准得到满足时,全局节点会进行定期异常模型培训,并生成更新的模型权重WWW,这些权重返回相关的边缘节点. 关于定期现场培训和领域适应进程的进一步详情见第三节D。

blocks.en: III-C Cloud and User Interaction
blocks.zh: 三-C 云与用户互动

blocks.en: The cloud node provides the communication interface between the distributed surveillance infrastructure and authorized end users. Object-level anomalies are forwarded directly from the edge node to the cloud to minimize alert latency. Behavior anomaly information is delivered together with the corresponding statistical analysis S ​ A SA generated by the global node. The cloud converts these events into alerts and user-interface information ( A , U ​ I ) (A,UI) , which are then delivered to user devices for remote monitoring and event review.
blocks.zh: 云节点提供分布式监视基础设施与授权终端用户之间的通信接口. 对象级异常从边缘节点直接传递到云中,以尽量减少警示时空. 行为异常信息与全球节点生成的相应统计分析S A SA一起提供. 云将这些事件转换成提示和用户界面信息(A,U I)(A,UI),然后交付用户设备进行远程监测和事件审查.

blocks.en: Communication is bidirectional. User requests and feedback ( R , F ​ B ) (R,FB) are returned through the cloud to support system interaction, event review, and subsequent analysis. By separating the user-facing cloud service from the global node responsible for statistical analysis and periodic model adaptation, YUTELA keeps alert delivery and user interaction independent of the more computationally intensive training and adaptation processes.
blocks.zh: 沟通是双向的。 用户请求和反馈(R,F B)(R,FB)通过云返回,以支持系统互动,事件审查,以及后续分析. YUTELA通过将用户提供云服务与负责统计分析和定期模型适应的全球节点区分开来,保持警报提供和用户互动独立于更计算密集的培训和适应进程。

blocks.en: III-D Edge Processing & Scene Specific Anomaly Adaptation
blocks.zh: III-D 边缘处理和场景特异性适应

blocks.en: Fig. 2: YUTELA edge processing and scene-specific adaptation architecture. Batched multi-camera streams share edge memory and inference resources, while anomaly features are collected at the global node for scene-specific model retraining.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:YUTELA边缘处理和场景特异性改造架构. Batched多相机流共享边缘内存和推论资源,而异常特征则在全球节点收集,用于场景特定模型再培训.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , each deployment location in YUTELA is associated with a single edge node responsible for processing all connected CCTV streams. Efficient resource sharing and workload scheduling have been explored in previous edge video analytics systems [ 3 , 6 , 7 ] . Unlike a conventional design in which each camera is assigned to an isolated end-to-end AI pipeline, YUTELA first performs camera batching and redistributes incoming streams across the available processing pipelines. This design decouples the number of active pipelines from the number of cameras. Under resource-constrained configurations, multiple camera streams can therefore share the same AI pipeline, reducing duplicated model instances and improving overall hardware utilization.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,YUTELA的每个部署地点都有一个单一的边缘节点,负责处理所有连接的闭路电视流。 以往的边缘视频分析系统[3、6、7]已探索了有效的资源分享和工作量安排。 与每台相机被分配到一个孤立的端对端AI管道的常规设计不同,YUTELA首先进行相机批量,并重新分配通过可用加工管道的进流. 这种设计将活动管道的数量与相机的数量脱钩. 在受资源限制的配置下,多个相机流因此可以共享相同的AI管道,减少重复的模型实例,提高整体硬件利用率.

blocks.en: After stream redistribution, YUTELA further reduces the processing overhead introduced by intermediate data movement between pipeline stages. CPU-side intermediate data are maintained within a shared memory allocation accessible across the processing stages, rather than repeatedly creating and copying redundant data between stages. This design reduces unnecessary memory allocation and CPU–GPU data transfer overhead, thereby improving end-to-end inference efficiency. The pipeline is also reorganized according to the computational characteristics of individual tasks. Lightweight operations that depend directly on upstream results are combined where possible; for example, pedestrian tracking is coupled with the object detection stage rather than being maintained as an independent processing module. Detection, pose estimation, and anomaly inference remain distributed across parallel pipelines, while their outputs are rebatched after anomaly detection. The merged data are then processed by shared downstream stages, including crop selection and feature extraction, since these operations do not require dedicated instances for each camera or inference pipeline. Selected features and associated metadata are subsequently transferred to the global node database for further analysis.
blocks.zh: 在流再分配后,YUTELA进一步减少了管道阶段之间中间数据移动引入的处理间接费用. CPU侧中间数据在可跨处理阶段共享的内存分配中保持,而不是在各阶段之间反复创建和复制冗余数据. 这种设计减少了不必要的内存分配和CPU–GPU数据传输的间接费用,从而提高了端到端的推论效率. 管道也根据单个任务的计算特征进行重组. 直接依赖于上游结果的轻量级操作尽可能合并;例如,行人跟踪与物体检测阶段相结合,而不是作为独立的处理模块加以维护. 探测、估计和反常推论仍然分布在平行管道之间,而其产出在反常探测后被推迟。 合并数据再由共享的下游阶段处理,包括作物选择和特征提取,因为这些操作不需要每个相机或推论管道的专门实例. 选定的特性和相关元数据随后被转移到全球节点数据库进行进一步分析。

blocks.en: Overall, YUTELA shifts the processing architecture from a camera-to-dedicated-pipeline design toward a location-level shared-resource architecture, in which multiple camera streams are distributed across the available edge processing resources. Beyond these system-level optimizations, YUTELA further extends the anomaly detection stage with scene-specific adaptation under changing deployment conditions.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,YUTELA将处理架构从相机到专用管式设计转向位置级共享资源架构,其中多个相机流分布在现有的边缘处理资源之间. 除了这些系统级优化外,YUTELA在不断变化的部署条件下,进一步延长异常探测阶段,进行场景特定改造.

blocks.en: For anomaly detection, YUTELA further addresses the domain-shift problem that arises during long-term real-world deployment. Unlike benchmark datasets, which typically contain a limited number of environments, deployed surveillance systems may experience substantial variations in camera viewpoint, illumination, background activity, crowd density, and scene dynamics [ 8 , 9 ] . Consequently, a single anomaly detection model trained on a fixed offline dataset may not generalize consistently across different camera scenes [ 41 , 10 , 51 ] . YUTELA therefore treats each camera as an individual domain and maintains a dedicated anomaly-detection model for each scene.
blocks.zh: 对于异常探测,YUTELA进一步解决了在长期现实世界部署过程中出现的域-转移问题. 与通常包含有限数量环境的基准数据集不同的是,部署的监视系统在镜头视角、照明、背景活动、人群密度和场景动态方面可能发生很大变化[8、9]。 因此,在固定离线数据集上训练的单一异常探测模型可能无法一致地跨越不同的镜头场景[41、10、51]。 YUTELA因此将每台相机作为单个域,并维持每个场景的专用异常探测模型.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , data generated by each local anomaly detector are continuously collected and pseudo-labeled following the data preparation strategy introduced in our previous work [ 51 , 52 ] . Although incoming samples are assigned pseudo-labels, only samples identified as normal are retained for model adaptation, since the anomaly detector is trained in a self-supervised manner using normal behavior [ 30 ] . The collected samples remain associated with their corresponding camera, ensuring that the training data reflect the characteristics of a specific deployment scene rather than being mixed across different domains.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,按照我们前一份工作中采用的数据编制战略[51、52],每个本地异常探测器生成的数据不断收集并贴上伪标签。 虽然传入的样品被分配到伪标签,但只有确认为正常的样品被保留用于模型改造,因为异常探测器是用正常行为进行自我监督的训练[30]. 所收集的样品仍然与其相应的相机相关,确保培训数据反映具体部署场景的特点,而不是在不同领域混合。

blocks.en: For each camera, scene-specific retraining is triggered after approximately one million frames containing valid human-pose observations have been accumulated, following the data-volume analysis in [ 51 ] . Only recently collected deployment data are used to construct the scene-specific training set, allowing the model to adapt to the current characteristics of the environment. Once the required data volume is reached, the selected samples are transferred to the global node, where periodic scene-specific anomaly training is performed. The updated model weights are then returned to the corresponding edge node and replace the previous anomaly model for that camera. This closed-loop process enables each deployed anomaly detector to progressively adapt to its local scene and mitigate performance degradation caused by domain shift.
blocks.zh: 每台相机,经过[51]中的数据量分析,累计了约100万帧包含有效人类拥有物观测结果的场景再培训,启动. 只是在最近才收集的部署数据用于构建特定场景的训练集,使该模型能够适应目前环境的特点。 一旦达到所要求的数据量,所选样本就会转移到全球节点,在那里进行定期的场景异常训练. 更新后的型号重量随后返回相应的边缘节点,并替换之前的该相机的异常型号. 这种闭路程序使每个部署的异常探测器能够逐步适应其局部场景,并减轻域位转移造成的性能退化.

blocks.en: IV Multi-Site Real-World Deployment
blocks.zh: 四. 多地点实际世界部署

blocks.en: To evaluate YUTELA beyond controlled benchmark environments, the complete system was deployed at four real-world surveillance sites: a university campus, a local market, a downtown restaurant, and an art center. These locations represent substantially different surveillance domains in terms of camera viewpoint, scene layout, pedestrian behavior, illumination, background activity, and operating environment. Such diversity provides a practical testbed for evaluating both the efficiency of the proposed edge-processing architecture and the ability of scene-specific anomaly adaptation to address domain shift across deployments.
blocks.zh: 为了在控制的基准环境之外评价YUTELA,在四个现实世界的监控地点部署了完整的系统:大学校园,当地市场,市中心餐厅,以及艺术中心. 这些地点在镜头视角、场景布局、行人行为、照明、背景活动和操作环境方面代表着截然不同的监视领域。 这种多样性为评价拟议边缘处理结构的效率以及因地制宜的异常情况适应能力以解决不同部署的域位转移提供了一个实际的试验台。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Representative camera views from the four real-world YUTELA deployment sites, including a university campus, local market, downtown restaurant, and art center. Two camera views are shown for each site to illustrate differences in scene layout, viewpoint, and deployment environment.
blocks.zh: 图3:四个真实世界YUTELA部署地点,包括一个大学校园、当地市场、市中心餐馆和艺术中心的代表镜头。 每个站点都显示两个镜头视图,以说明场景布局、视角和部署环境的差异。

blocks.en: IV-A Deployment Sites
blocks.zh: 部署地点

blocks.en: All deployments use existing network-connected CCTV cameras already installed at the corresponding locations. YUTELA therefore operates under the camera placement, viewing angle, image quality, illumination, and scene conditions of practical surveillance systems rather than cameras installed specifically for the experiment. As shown in Fig. 3 , the four sites differ substantially in scene layout and visual characteristics. Each site provides at least seven concurrent camera streams to a local edge node, while each camera is treated as an independent scene with its own anomaly-detection model and scene specific adaptation process.
blocks.zh: 所有部署都使用已在相应地点安装的现有网络连接闭路电视摄像机。 因此,YUTELA在照相机布置,取景角度,图像质量,照明,以及实际监视系统的场景条件下运作,而不是专门为实验安装的照相机. 如图3所示,四个站点在场景布局和视觉特征上差异很大. 每个站点至少提供7个平行的相机流到一个局部边缘节点,而每个相机则作为独立的场景处理,具有自己的异常探测模型和场景特定适应过程.

blocks.en: The four testbeds were selected to represent different types of public and community spaces within the same urban area. Together, they cover education, commerce, recreation, and cultural activities and provide substantially different crowd patterns, operating schedules, lighting conditions, and camera viewpoints. These differences create a useful real world setting for evaluating both multi-camera edge processing and scene specific anomaly adaptation.
blocks.zh: 选择这四个试验台是为了代表同一城市地区内不同类型的公共和社区空间。 它们共同涵盖教育、商业、娱乐和文化活动,提供完全不同的人群模式、运行时间表、照明条件和摄像头观点。 这些差异为评价多镜头边缘处理和场景特殊异常适应创造了有用的真实世界环境。

blocks.en: Site A – Urban College: The campus environment includes outdoor walkways, road crossings, and building entrances. Pedestrian activity follows regular daytime and academic schedules, while most cameras observe relatively open scenes with moderate traffic. The deployment uses eight cameras operating at FHD and 30 FPS.
blocks.zh: A站点 — 城市学院: 校园环境包括户外步行道,路口,以及建筑入口. 行人活动遵循常规的日间和学术时间安排,而大多数摄像头则以适度流量观察相对开放的场景. 部署使用8台在FHD操作的摄像机和30台FPS.

blocks.en: Site B – Dining and Nightlife Complex: This site contains restaurants and other entertainment spaces within a high traffic downtown environment. Camera views include entrances, pedestrian areas, and shared public spaces. Activity is generally denser than at Site A and can increase significantly during evening and late night periods. The deployment uses seven cameras operating at FHD and 30 FPS.
blocks.zh: B站点 — 晚饭和夜生活综合体: 该网站包含在高流量市区环境中的餐厅和其他娱乐空间. 摄影景点包括入口,行人区,以及共用的公共空间. 活动一般比A站点密集,在晚间和深夜期间可以显著增加. 部署使用7台在FHD操作的摄像机和30台FPS.

blocks.en: Site C – Public Marketplace: The marketplace contains retail, dining, and common gathering areas with frequent changes in crowd density throughout the day. Activity is often concentrated around meal periods and weekends, producing irregular and occasionally dense pedestrian flow. The deployment uses eight cameras operating at HD and 15 FPS.
blocks.zh: C站点-公共市场: 市场包括零售、餐饮和常见的集聚区,整个白天人群密度经常变化。 活动往往集中在膳食时间和周末,产生不规则和偶尔密集的行人流量. 部署使用8台在HD操作的摄像机和15台FPS.

blocks.en: Site D – Community Arts Center: The arts center includes exhibition, event, and public gathering spaces. Compared with the marketplace and nightlife site, normal activity is generally lower but can change rapidly during scheduled events. The deployment uses eight cameras operating at FHD and 20 FPS.
blocks.zh: D站点-社区 艺术中心: 艺术中心包括展览、活动和公共集会空间。 与市场和夜间生活地点相比,正常活动一般较低,但在预定活动期间可以迅速变化。 部署使用8台在FHD操作的摄像机和20台FPS.

blocks.en: The selected sites also represent community-facing public environments where scalable and locally processed video analytics may provide practical value without requiring dedicated high end computing infrastructure. From a video anomaly detection perspective, these deployments provide distinct camera domains with different background structures, crowd densities, lighting conditions, activity patterns, and operating schedules. The definition of normal behavior therefore varies across both sites and individual cameras. This multi-site setting provides a realistic environment for evaluating the scene specific adaptation mechanism described in Section III-D .
blocks.zh: 选定的网站还代表着社区化的公共环境,在这些环境中,可扩展的和当地处理的视频分析可以提供实用价值,而不需要专门的高端计算基础设施。 从视频异常探测的角度来看,这些部署提供了不同的相机域,具有不同的背景结构、人群密度、照明条件、活动模式和运行时间表。 因此,各站点和个人相机对正常行为的定义各不相同。 这种多地点环境为评估第三节D部分所述场景特定适应机制提供了一个现实的环境。

blocks.en: IV-B Edge and Global Computing Platforms
blocks.zh: 四-B 边缘和全球计算平台

blocks.en: Each deployment location is equipped with an NVIDIA Jetson Thor that serves as the local YUTELA edge node. All camera streams from the corresponding site are transmitted to this device, where camera batching, perception, tracking, pose estimation, anomaly detection, and downstream feature processing are performed using the shared edge-processing architecture described in Section III-D . Processing multiple cameras on a single edge platform also allows the experiments to evaluate the memory and inference efficiency of YUTELA under realistic multi-camera workloads.
blocks.zh: 每个部署地点都配备了NVIDIA喷气机 索尔是当地的YUTELA边缘节点. 从相应站点发送到此设备的所有相机流,其中相机批量,感知,跟踪,姿势估计,异常检测,下游特征处理使用第三节-D节描述的共享边缘处理架构. 在单边平台上处理多个相机也使得实验能够在现实的多相机工作量下评价YUTELA的内存和推论效率.

blocks.en: A centralized workstation serves as the global node for all four deployment sites. The workstation is equipped with an AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX 32-core processor and two NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs. Unlike the edge nodes, which prioritize continuous low-latency inference under constrained resources, the global node provides the computational capacity required for centralized data management, statistical analysis, and scene-specific anomaly-model training.
blocks.zh: 集中工作站是所有四个部署地点的全球节点。 工作站配备了AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX 32核心处理器和两台NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. 与边缘节点在有限的资源下优先进行连续低纬度推论不同,全球节点提供了集中数据管理,统计分析和场景特异性模型培训所需的计算能力.

blocks.en: All four edge nodes communicate with the same global node through the available network infrastructure. This configuration reflects the intended YUTELA deployment model in which inference resources are distributed across physical locations while computationally intensive model adaptation is consolidated on a shared global server.
blocks.zh: 所有四个边缘节点都通过现有的网络基础设施与同一个全球节点通信. 这种配置反映了设想的YUTELA部署模型,其中推论资源在物理地点之间分配,而计算密集的模型调整则合并在一个共享的全球服务器上。

blocks.en: IV-C Operational Workflow and Communication
blocks.zh: 业务工作流量和通信

blocks.en: During deployment, live CCTV streams are continuously ingested by the corresponding Jetson Thor edge node. Camera streams from the same location are batched and distributed across the available AI pipelines. Real-time perception and anomaly inference are performed locally, with each camera maintaining its own scene-specific anomaly model. In parallel, selected anomaly features, contextual metadata, and pseudo-labeled training samples are associated with their originating location and camera ID and transferred to the global node for statistical analysis and scene-specific model adaptation. Once sufficient recent training data have been accumulated for a camera, the global node performs periodic retraining and returns the updated weights to the corresponding edge node.
blocks.zh: 在部署期间,闭路电视直播流不断被相应的Jetson Thor边缘节点摄入。 同一地点的相机流经过批量,并分布在现有的AI管道中. 实时感知和异常推论在当地进行,每台相机都维护自己的场景特异性模型. 与此同时,一些选定的异常特征、背景元数据以及伪标签培训样本与其原产地和相机ID相关,并转移到全球节点进行统计分析和针对具体场景的模型改造。 一旦为相机积累了足够的最新培训数据,全球节点将进行定期再培训,并将更新的权重返回相应的边缘节点。

blocks.en: Continuous raw video transmission to the global node or cloud is therefore not required during normal operation. Communication is primarily limited to selected features, training data, statistical information, model synchronization, and updated model weights. This design reduces network dependence for real-time inference while enabling centralized model adaptation across multiple deployment sites.
blocks.zh: 因此,在正常运行期间不需要向全球节点或云持续传输原始视频. 交流主要限于选定特征,培训数据,统计信息,模型同步,更新模型权重. 这种设计降低了网络对实时推断的依赖性,同时使多个部署地点能够对模型进行集中调整。

blocks.en: V Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 五. 实验评价

blocks.en: We evaluate YUTELA through three complementary experiments that progress from controlled system benchmarking to long-term real-world operation. First, we benchmark the edge node using prerecorded surveillance video [ 53 ] under different scene densities and camera concurrency levels. This experiment quantifies the computational performance of the embedded implementation and compares it with the workstation-based Ancilia system [ 4 , 11 ] . Second, we deploy the complete YUTELA framework at four real-world sites and operate the system continuously for a 170-hour, approximately one week, observation period. This experiment evaluates end-to-end runtime performance and the behavior of the centralized adaptation workflow under realistic workloads. Third, we evaluate the end-to-end processing latency of anomaly alerts triggered under real-world deployment conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个补充实验对YUTELA进行评估,这些实验从控制系统基准化到长期的实际操作。 首先,我们用预先录制的监视录像来设定边缘节点的基准 [53] 在不同场景密度和相机的货币水平下。 这个实验将嵌入式执行的计算性能量化,并与基于工作站的Ancilia系统[4,11]进行比较. 第二,我们在四个现实世界地点部署完整的YUTELA框架,并持续运行该系统170小时,大约一周,观察期。 这个实验评价了端到端的运行时间性能以及现实工作量下的集中适应工作流程的行为. 第三,我们评价在现实世界部署条件下触发的异常警报的端到端处理延迟性。

blocks.en: Together, these experiments address three system-level questions: 1) whether an embedded edge node can provide sufficient multi-camera processing capability to replace the workstation class hardware, 2) whether the complete distributed system can operate reliably across real-world deployments while supporting camera-specific model updates, and 3) whether the deployed system can deliver anomaly alerts with practical end-to-end latency under different real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: 这些实验共同涉及三个系统层面的问题: 1)嵌入式边缘节点是否能够提供足够的多相机处理能力来取代工作站类硬件,2)完整的分布式系统是否能够在支持相机专用模型更新的同时,在现实世界的不同条件下可靠地在整个现实世界部署中运行,3)被部署的系统是否能够以实际的端到端延迟来发出异常警报.

blocks.en: V-A 1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: V-A 1 实验设置

blocks.en: The first experiment isolates the edge processing node and evaluates its computational efficiency under controlled video workloads. We compare three system configurations: the original Ancilia implementation [ 4 ] running on a workstation-class setup with a Threadripper Pro 3975WX CPU and three A6000 GPUs, YUTELA running on the NVIDIA Jetson Thor, and YUTELA running on the same Jetson Thor with TensorRT-optimized perception models. The second configuration includes the redesigned pipeline described in Section III-D , including camera redistribution, shared memory, reduced inter-stage data transfer, and stage integration, with the models executed in their original framework. The third configuration adds TensorRT acceleration to this pipeline, so the difference between the two YUTELA configurations isolates the effect of TensorRT. Because the Jetson Thor has substantially less compute than the workstation, the comparison with Ancilia reflects the combined effect of the hardware change and the software redesign.
blocks.zh: 第一次实验将边缘处理节点隔离,并在可控视频工作量下评价其计算效率. 我们比较了三种系统配置:最初的Ancilia执行[4]运行在一个工作站级设置上,有一个Threadripper Pro 3975WX CPU和三个A6000 GPU,YUTELA运行在NVIDIA Jetson Thor上,YUTELA运行在同一个Jetson Thor上,使用TensorRT-优化感知模型. 第二种配置包括第三节-D部分描述的重新设计的管道,包括相机再分配,共享内存,减少阶段间数据传输,以及阶段整合,模型在原框架内执行. 第三个配置为这个管道增加了TensorRT加速度,因此两个YUTELA配置的区别隔离了TensorRT的效果. 因为杰森 Thor的计算率大大低于工作站,与Ancilia的比较反映了硬件变化和软件重新设计的综合效果.

blocks.en: To characterize the effect of scene complexity, we use prerecorded surveillance video representing three workload levels: normal, heavy, and extreme crowd density. The workloads contain approximately 70, 216, and 744 detections per second, respectively. Each workload is evaluated using 1, 4, and 8 concurrent camera streams. This controlled configuration allows the effect of camera concurrency and scene density to be evaluated independently of variations in network conditions or deployment duration.
blocks.zh: 为了描述场景复杂的影响,我们使用预录的监控视频,代表三个工作量级别:正常的,沉重的,以及极端的人群密度. 工作量分别为每秒约70次、216次和744次。 利用1、4和8个并行相机流对每一工作量进行评估。 这种可控配置可以将相机的同位素和场景密度的效果与网络条件或部署期限的变化分开来评价.

blocks.en: For each configuration, we measure processing throughput and end-to-end pipeline latency. The experiment therefore evaluates both the computational scalability of the embedded implementation and the benefit provided by TensorRT optimization.
blocks.zh: 对于每个配置,我们测量处理的吞吐量和端到端的管道延迟. 因此,该实验既评价嵌入式执行的计算可扩展性,也评价TensorRT优化提供的效益.

blocks.en: V-A 2 Edge-Node Performance
blocks.zh: V-A 2 边点性能

blocks.en: Fig. 4 plots the throughput and latency of the three system configurations as the number of camera streams grows, with one panel per crowd density. Three trends are visible. First, directly moving the pipeline to the embedded platform (blue dotted line) causes a clear drop in throughput and a steep rise in latency as streams are added, even though its single-stream performance is similar to or better than that of the workstation. Second, TensorRT optimization (red solid line) lifts throughput above the workstation (gray dashed line) in seven of the nine settings, and the gap widens as scene density increases. Third, latency grows with the number of streams for all configurations. With four or eight streams under normal and heavy density, the optimized edge node still has higher latency than the workstation, so the gain from the edge platform is mainly in throughput rather than in response time.
blocks.zh: 图4绘制了随着相机流数的增加,三个系统配置的吞吐量和耐久性,每个人群密度各有一个面板. 三种趋势可见. 首先,将管道直接移动到嵌入式平台(蓝色点线),造成吞吐量明显下降,随着溪流的加入,纬度也急剧上升,尽管其单流性能与工作站相似或更好. 其次,TensorRT优化(红色固态线)在9个设置中的7个设置中将吞吐量提升到工作站以上(灰色破碎线),随着场景密度的增大,缺口会扩大. 第三,随所有配置的溪流数量而增加。 由于在正常和重密度下有四,八条溪流,优化后的边缘节点仍然比工作站具有更高的耐久性,因此从边缘平台得到的收益主要是吞吐量而不是反应时间.

blocks.en: For the normal density workload with eight camera streams, TensorRT increases throughput from 14.17 FPS to 29.94 FPS compared with the unoptimized YUTELA implementation, an improvement of approximately 111%. At the same time, latency decreases from 9.91 s to 5.07 s. The optimized edge implementation also slightly exceeds the 26.60 FPS achieved by the Ancilia workstation under the same workload, although its latency remains higher than the workstation’s 2.84 s.
blocks.zh: 就正常密度工作量而言,有八条相机流,TensorRT将吞吐量从14.17 FPS增加到29.94 FPS,相比之下,YUTELA的实施没有达到最佳水平,提高了约111%. 同时,耐性也从9.91s降至5.07s. 优化的边缘实施也略高于安西利亚工作站在同一工作量下达到的26.60 FPS,尽管其耐久性仍然高于工作站的2.84 s.

blocks.en: The improvement is also clear under higher scene density. With eight streams under the heavy-density workload, TensorRT increases throughput from 10.97 FPS to 25.97 FPS, compared with 15.48 FPS on the original Ancilia workstation, while latency (10.70 s) remains close to the workstation’s 9.54 s. Under the extreme-density workload, the optimized edge implementation reaches 8.48 FPS, compared with 4.47 FPS without TensorRT and 4.18 FPS on the Ancilia workstation. Latency is also reduced from 48.33 s to 26.19 s compared with the unoptimized edge implementation, which is the only eight-stream setting in which the edge node is faster than the workstation (31.19 s). More generally, the advantage of the optimized edge pipeline grows with scene density: with eight streams, its throughput is 1.13, 1.68, and 2.03 times that of the workstation under normal, heavy, and extreme density, respectively. This is likely because per-person stages such as pose estimation and anomaly inference dominate the workload in crowded scenes and benefit most from TensorRT acceleration.
blocks.zh: 在较高的场景密度下,情况也明显改善。 由于重密度工作量下有8条溪流,TensorRT的吞吐量从10.97 FPS增加到25.97 FPS,而原安西利亚工作站的吞吐量为15.48 FPS,而耐用度(10.70s)仍然接近工作站的9.54s. 在极端密度工作量下,优化的边缘执行达到8.48 FPS,相比之下,安西利亚工作站上没有TensorRT的FPS为4.47 FPS为4.18 FPS. 与未优化的边缘执行相比,延迟度也从48.33s降至26.19s,这是边缘节点比工作站更快(31.19s)的唯一八流设置. 更普遍地说,优化边缘管道的优势随着场景密度的增长而增长:有8条溪流,其吞吐量分别是正常,重,极端密度下工作站的1.13,1.68和2.03倍. 这可能是因为,在拥挤的场景中,假设和反常推论等人均阶段占了工作量的主导地位,并且从TensorRT加速中获利最大。

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that simply moving Ancilia from a workstation to an embedded device is not enough to maintain its original performance. With inference optimization, however, YUTELA can support multi-camera processing on the edge while achieving performance comparable to, and in some cases higher than, the workstation-based system. The results also show that both the number of camera streams and scene density have a strong effect on throughput and latency, which motivates the long-term real-world evaluation presented next.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,结果显示,简单地将安西莉娅从工作站移动到嵌入式设备不足以维持其原始性能. 然而,随着推论优化,YUTELA可以在边缘支持多相机处理,同时实现与基于工作站的系统相可比的性能,有时甚至更高. 研究结果还表明,相机流的数量和场景密度都对吞吐量和耐久性有着强烈的影响,这激励了接下来提出的长期现实世界评价.

blocks.zh: V-B 现实世界多地点部署

blocks.en: V-B 1 Deployment Setup
blocks.zh: V-B 1 部署设置

blocks.en: The second experiment evaluates the complete YUTELA system during continuous real-world operation. YUTELA is deployed at four local sites with different camera layouts, scene characteristics, activity levels, and operating conditions. Unlike the controlled edge-node benchmark, this experiment covers the full system workflow, including camera ingestion, edge inference, anomaly processing, and centralized periodic training.
blocks.zh: 第二次实验评价了整个YUTELA系统在持续现实世界运行期间的运行. YUTELA部署在四个当地站点,具有不同的相机布局,场景特征,活动级别,操作条件. 与控制边缘-节点基准不同,这一实验涵盖了整个系统的工作流程,包括摄入相机,边缘推论,异常处理,以及集中的定期训练.

blocks.en: The four sites are described in Section IV-A : an urban college (Site A), a dining and nightlife complex (Site B), a public marketplace (Site C), and a community arts center (Site D). Together they use 31 cameras, seven or eight per site, with input frame rates from 15 to 30 FPS. All sites are evaluated over the same continuous 170-hour observation period.
blocks.zh: 第四至A节对这四个地点作了描述:一个城市学院(Site A)、一个餐饮和夜间生活综合体(Site B)、一个公共市场(Site C)和一个社区艺术中心(Site D)。 它们总共使用31个相机,每个站点7或8个,输入帧率从15到30 FPS. 所有地点都在同一持续170小时的观察期间进行评估。

blocks.en: During deployment, we record both runtime system performance and adaptation activity. Runtime measurements include the minimum processing rate observed per camera and the maximum pipeline latency. For adaptation, we record the total number of training triggers, the number of triggers for each camera, the interval between successive training events, and the execution time of each training process.
blocks.zh: 在部署期间,我们记录运行时间系统性能和适应活动。 运行时间测量包括每台相机观测到的最低处理率和最大管道延迟. 为了适应,我们记录训练触发器的总数,每台相机的触发器数量,连续训练活动的间隔时间,以及每次训练过程的执行时间.

blocks.en: V-B 2 Long-Term Runtime Performance
blocks.zh: V-B 2 长期运行时间业绩

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the deployment settings, runtime performance, and periodic-training activity observed across the four sites. The results show that YUTELA remains operational under different real-world workloads, while throughput and latency vary with both scene activity and camera input settings.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了四个地点的部署设置、运行时间业绩和定期培训活动。 结果显示,YUTELA仍在不同的现实世界工作量下运作,而吞吐量和耐久性则因场景活动和相机输入设置而异.

blocks.en: Site A represents the campus deployment with eight 30-FPS camera streams. The system reaches a minimum processing rate of 10.96 FPS per camera and a maximum observed latency of 16.71 s. Although pedestrian activity on campus is generally continuous, most cameras are directed toward road crossings, sidewalks, and outward-facing areas rather than dense indoor spaces. As a result, the number of people detected within the camera views remains relatively limited, reducing the processing load compared with more crowded sites.
blocks.zh: 站点 A代表校园部署,配有8台30FPS相机流. 系统达到每台相机10.96 FPS的最低处理率,观测到的最大空闲度为16.71秒. 虽然校园内的行人活动一般是连续的,但大多数摄像头都指向路口,人行道和外向区域,而不是密集的室内空间. 因此,相机观看中检测到的人数仍然相对有限,与较为拥挤的站点相比,加工负荷减少.

blocks.en: Site B provides a more demanding workload. The downtown restaurant contains seven 30-FPS camera streams and experiences higher and more frequent pedestrian activity. The minimum processing rate decreases to 2.98 FPS per camera, while the maximum latency reaches 37.38 s. As shown in Fig. 5b , the stronger variation in pedestrian flow is closely reflected in the runtime behavior, making this deployment a useful example of YUTELA operating under sustained higher load.
blocks.zh: 站点 B提供了更艰巨的工作量。 市中心餐厅包含7个30-FPS摄像头溪流,体验更多更频繁的行人活动. 最低处理率降至2.98 FPS/每台相机,而最高潜伏度达到37.38s. 如图5b所示,行人流量的较大变化在运行时间行为中得到了密切的反映,使得这一部署成为YUTELA在持续较高负荷下运行的有益例子.

blocks.en: Sites C and D also show that camera frame rate affects system latency in addition to scene activity. Site C, the food-market deployment, has pedestrian flow comparable to Site B in several periods, but its cameras provide 15-FPS input streams. The TensorRT inference pipeline uses a fixed 30-frame input batch, requiring the system to wait longer to form a complete batch from a 15-FPS stream. This introduces approximately one additional second of data collection before inference and contributes to a different latency pattern from the 30-FPS restaurant deployment, even when the observed traffic level is similar.
blocks.zh: 站点C和D还显示,相机帧速率除了场景活动外,还会影响系统耐久性. C站点,即食品市场部署,在几个时期有与B站点相当的行人流,但其摄像头提供15-FPS输入流. TensorRT推论管道采用固定的30帧输入批量,要求系统等待更长的时间才能从15FPS流形成完整的批量. 这在推断前增加了大约一秒钟的数据收集工作,有助于形成与30个FPS餐厅部署不同的延迟模式,即使所观察到的流量水平相似。

blocks.en: A similar effect is observed at Site D, the art-center deployment, where the cameras operate at 20 FPS and pedestrian activity is generally lower. Its runtime behavior falls between the higher-frame-rate campus deployment and the lower-frame-rate food-market deployment. Together, Sites A–D show that real-world performance depends not only on the number of cameras and the number of detected people, but also on the input frame rate and the time required to prepare inference batches.
blocks.zh: 在艺术中心部署的D站点也观察到类似效果,在那里,摄像头在20 FPS操作,行人活动一般较低. 它的运行时间行为介于更高帧率的校园部署和较低帧率的粮食市场部署之间. 站点A-D一起显示,现实世界的性能不仅取决于摄像头的数量和检测到的人数,还取决于输入帧率和准备推断批次所需的时间.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows the long-term runtime behavior of YUTELA at all four sites over the same week. The lower plot in each panel traces the daily rhythm of each location, and the upper plot shows how the edge pipeline responds to it.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了YUTELA在同一周所有四个站点的长期运行行为. 每个面板的下图跟踪每个位置的日常节奏,上图显示边缘管道是如何响应它的.

blocks.en: The peak pedestrian-flow measurements further show the differences between the four workloads. Site C reaches the highest peak flow of 77, followed by Site B at 63, while Sites A and D reach peaks of 29 and 30, respectively. These results show that camera count alone does not fully describe the processing load of a deployed surveillance system. Scene activity, input frame rate, and the number of detected people can all change the amount of work required by the edge.
blocks.zh: 高峰行人流量测量进一步显示这四个工作量的差异. 站点 C达到最高高峰流量77,其次是B站点63,而A站点和D站点分别达到29和30峰. 这些结果显示,光是摄像头计数并不能充分描述部署的监视系统的处理负荷. 场景活动,输入帧速率,以及检测到的人数都能够改变边缘所需的工作量.

blocks.en: The same deployments are also used to evaluate YUTELA’s periodic scene-specific training process. Across the four sites, the system generates 101 training triggers during the 170-hour observation period, although the number and timing of these events differ considerably between sites.
blocks.zh: 同样的部署也被用来评价YUTELA定期的现场训练过程. 在整个四个地点,该系统在170小时的观察期间产生了101个训练触发器,不过这些活动的次数和时间因地点而大不相同。

blocks.en: Site A generates nine training events, with an average inter-trigger interval of 55.0 ± 20.4 55.0\pm 20.4 h. Site B generates 59 events and has the shortest average interval of 19.4 ± 4.6 19.4\pm 4.6 h. Sites C and D generate 20 and 13 events, with average intervals of 42.2 ± 6.3 42.2\pm 6.3 h and 41.0 ± 12.8 41.0\pm 12.8 h, respectively. These differences reflect the data-volume-based periodic adaptation strategy introduced in our previous work [ 51 ] : training is triggered by the amount of usable scene-specific data collected by each camera rather than by a fixed update schedule.
blocks.zh: 站点 A产生9个训练活动,平均触发间隔为55.0±20.4 55.0\pm 20.4h. B站点产生59个事件,平均间隔最短为19.4±4.6 19.4\pm 4.6h. C站点和D站点产生20和13个事件,平均间隔分别为42.2±6.3 42.2\pm 6.3 h和41.0± 12.8 41.0\pm 12.8 h. 这些差异反映了我们先前工作中采用的基于数据量的定期适应战略[51]:培训是由每台相机收集的可用场景特定数据的数量而不是固定的更新时间表触发的。

blocks.en: Despite the variation in trigger frequency, individual training events remain relatively short. The average training time ranges from 4.2 ± 2.4 4.2\pm 2.4 min at Site A to 7.7 ± 4.4 7.7\pm 4.4 min at Site B. Because training is performed on the centralized global server rather than on the Jetson Thor edge nodes, model updates do not occupy the edge GPU used for continuous video inference.
blocks.zh: 尽管触发频率不同,但个别培训活动仍然较短。 平均训练时间从A站点的4.2±2.4 4.2\pm 2.4分钟到B站点的7.7±4.4 7.7\pm 4.4分钟不等. 由于训练是在中央全球服务器上进行,而不是在Jetson Thor边缘节点上进行,模型更新并不占据用于连续视频推断的边缘GPU.

blocks.en: Overall, the long-term deployment shows two important characteristics of YUTELA. First, runtime performance changes with the actual scene workload and camera configuration rather than camera count alone. Second, the amount of scene-specific training data collected varies across deployments, causing different cameras and sites to require model updates at different times. This supports the use of a data-driven training trigger instead of applying the same fixed retraining schedule to every deployment.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,长期部署显示了YUTELA的两个重要特征. 首先,运行时间性能随着实际场景工作量和相机配置的变化而改变,而不是独自计算. 其次,所收集的场景特定培训数据数量因部署而异,导致不同的相机和站点在不同的时间需要模型更新. 这支持使用数据驱动的培训触发器,而不是对每次部署都采用相同的固定再培训时间表。

blocks.en: V-C End-to-End Alert Processing Latency
blocks.zh: V-C 端到端警报处理延迟

blocks.en: In addition to frame-processing throughput, we evaluate the end-to-end latency of real world anomaly alert generation. Following the PCP evaluation procedure introduced in [ 8 ] , the measurement covers the complete processing path from camera input to the final anomaly alert, rather than the execution time of an individual model. Both object level and behavior level anomaly processing are evaluated.
blocks.zh: 除帧处理吞吐量外,我们还评价了真实世界异常警报生成的端到端延迟性. 按照[8]中引入的五氯苯酚评价程序,测量涵盖从摄像头输入到最后异常警报的完整处理路径,而不是单个模型的执行时间。 对对象级别和行为级别异常处理均进行评价.

blocks.en: To conduct the experiment under representative operating conditions, we visited all four deployment sites during their typical busy periods, selected based on the traffic patterns observed during the long-term deployment experiment. At each site, object-anomaly and behavior-anomaly events were triggered separately. Each scenario was repeated 15 times, and the resulting end-to-end latency was recorded to calculate the mean, standard deviation, and observed range.
blocks.zh: 为了在具有代表性的作业条件下进行试验,我们在典型的繁忙时期视察了所有四个部署地点,这些地点是根据长期部署试验期间观察到的交通模式选定的。 每个站点分别触发物体异常和行为异常事件. 每种情况都重复了15次,并记录了由此产生的端到端延迟,以计算平均偏差,标准偏差和观测范围.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Physical-Cyber-Physcial alert-trigger latency for object and behavior anomalies with eight concurrent surveillance cameras under different traffic flows. The Ancilia baseline is reported from [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 表三:不同交通流量下8台同时监控摄像头对物体和行为异常的物理-循环-物理预警-触发纬度. [8] 报告安西利亚基线。

blocks.en: Table III summarizes the results together with the previous measurement reported in [ 8 ] . In that experiment, Ancilia achieved an object anomaly latency of 8.92 ± 0.71 8.92\pm 0.71 s and a behavior anomaly latency of 11.62 ± 0.62 11.62\pm 0.62 s using eight concurrent cameras at Location B.
blocks.zh: 表三汇总了结果以及先前在[8]中报告的衡量结果。 在实验中,安西莉娅实现了8.92±0.71 8.92\pm 0.71s的物体异常潜伏度,以及11.62±0.62 11.62\pm的行为异常潜伏度. 0.62在B位置使用八台同时相机。

blocks.en: For YUTELA, the measured latency varies across deployment sites and traffic conditions. Under lower traffic flow, such as Sites A and D, object anomaly latency remains between approximately 6.8 and 7.6 s on average, while behavior anomaly latency remains below 10 s. Under the higher traffic conditions observed at Sites B and C, both object and behavior processing require more time, reflecting the additional workload introduced by larger numbers of detected people and downstream features. Among the four deployments, Site A achieves the lowest average object-anomaly latency at 6.82 ± 0.57 6.82\pm 0.57 s, while Site B shows the highest average latency at 11.33 ± 0.69 11.33\pm 0.69 s for object anomalies and 15.41 ± 0.74 15.41\pm 0.74 s for behavior anomalies. Sites C and D fall between these two cases. These results are consistent with the long term runtime evaluation, where scene activity and camera configuration were shown to directly affect the processing workload of the edge pipeline.
blocks.zh: 就YUTELA而言,不同部署地点和交通条件的延迟程度各不相同。 在A站点和D站点等流量较低的流量下,物体异常延迟平均保持在约6.8至7.6s之间,而行为异常延迟持续在10s以下. 在B站点和C站点所观察到的较高的交通条件下,物体和行为处理都需要更多的时间,这反映了被检测到的人数和下游特征的增加所带来的额外工作量. 在四项部署中,A站点的平均物体异常潜伏度最低,为6.82±0.57 6.82\pm 0.57;B站点的平均潜伏度最高,为11.33±0.69 11.33\pm 0.69 s,物体异常度最高,15.41±0.74 15.41\pm。 行为异常0.74 s. C站点和D站点位于这两起案件之间。 这些结果与长期运行时间评价一致,该评价显示场景活动和相机配置会直接影响边缘管道的处理工作量.

blocks.en: The measurements should not be interpreted as a direct one to one comparison between sites or with the previous Ancilia experiment, since the deployments use different cameras, environments, input frame rates, and traffic conditions. Instead, the experiment provides a practical view of the alert latency that can be expected when YUTELA operates in real world environments. The results also suggest that the redesigned edge pipeline can maintain relatively low alert latency under lighter traffic, while latency increases as scene activity and processing demand become higher.
blocks.zh: 不应将测量解释为在地点之间或与以前的安西利亚实验进行直接比对,因为部署使用不同的摄像机、环境、输入帧率和交通条件。 相反,该实验提供了YUTELA在现实世界环境中运行时可以预期的警示延迟的实用视角. 研究结果还表明,重新设计的边缘管道在较轻的流量下可以保持相对较低的警备潜伏状态,而随着场景活动和处理需求增加,潜伏状态会增加.

blocks.en: V-D Lessons Learned and Limitations
blocks.zh: 五-D 经验教训和局限性

blocks.en: The three experiments evaluate YUTELA from edge efficiency to complete real-world operation, and together they suggest several lessons for deploying video anomaly detection on existing city camera infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 这三项实验从边缘效率评价YUTELA到完成现实世界的操作,它们共同提出了在现有的城市摄像机基础设施上部署视频异常探测的若干经验教训。

blocks.en: Edge hardware trades latency for throughput: The controlled benchmark shows that the Jetson Thor can replace a workstation with three A6000 GPUs for multi-camera processing, but only after TensorRT optimization. The optimized edge node exceeds the workstation’s throughput in seven of nine settings, and its advantage grows with crowd density. However, with four or eight streams under normal and heavy density, its latency remains higher than the workstation’s. For applications that require the shortest possible response time at low load, a workstation remains faster. For deployments across many sites, the edge node offers comparable or higher throughput on a much smaller platform.
blocks.zh: 边际硬件交易吞吐量的耐久性: 控制基准显示,Jetson Thor可以用3台A6000GPU取代一个工作站进行多镜头处理,但只能在TensorRT优化后进行. 优化的边缘节点超过工作站在9个设置中的7个情况下的吞吐量,其优势随着人群密度的增长而增加. 然而,由于四、八条溪流处于正常和重密度之下,其耐久性仍然高于工作站。 对于在低负荷时需要尽可能短的反应时间的应用程序,工作站仍保持较快的速度. 对于跨越许多场地的部署,边缘节点在更小的平台上提供可比或更高的吞吐量.

blocks.en: Camera count is a poor proxy for workload: The long-term deployment shows that throughput and latency follow pedestrian activity, detected-object flow, and input frame rate, not the number of cameras. Site B, with seven cameras, was the most demanding site, while Site A, with eight cameras at the same frame rate, maintained the highest minimum processing rate. Input frame rate also interacts with batching: at the 15-FPS marketplace site, filling a fixed 30-frame batch adds about one second before processing begins. Edge resources should therefore be planned from expected scene activity and camera configuration rather than from camera count alone.
blocks.zh: 摄像头数是工作量的劣质代词: 长期部署显示,吞吐量和耐力跟随行人活动,检测到的物体流,以及输入帧率,而不是摄像头的数量. 拥有7个摄像头的B站点是要求最高的站点,而具有同样帧率的8个摄像头的A站点则保持了最高的最低处理率. 输入帧率也与批量发生相互作用:在15-FPS市场站点,填充固定的30帧批量在开始处理前增加约1秒. 因此,边缘资源应当从预期的场景活动和摄像机配置中规划,而不是仅仅从摄像机计数中规划。

blocks.en: Data-driven retraining triggers adapt to each scene: Because retraining is triggered by the amount of collected pose data rather than by a fixed schedule, its frequency followed scene activity, from a mean interval of 19.4 h at Site B to 55.0 h at Site A. A fixed schedule would either retrain quiet cameras with little new data or update busy cameras too rarely. The centralized training load was small: all 101 events together occupied about 6.6% of one GPU over the observation period, and the linear projection suggests that a single global node can support tens of sites.
blocks.zh: 数据驱动的再培训触发器适应每个场景: 由于再培训是由收集的姿势数据数量而不是固定时间表触发的,其频率随场景活动而变化,从B站点的平均间隔为19.4小时到A站点的55.0小时。 固定的时间表要么是重新训练没有新数据的静悄悄的摄像机,要么是很少更新繁忙的摄像机。 集中式训练负载很小:在观测期间,所有101场活动共占一个GPU的约6.6%,线性预测表明,一个单一的全球节点可以支持数十个站点.

blocks.en: Limitations: This study evaluates system efficiency, multi-site operation, and the adaptation workflow, but not whether the updated models detect anomalies more accurately than the initial ones. Measuring this would require manually verified anomaly labels for every camera scene, which is outside the scope of this work. Because retraining relies on pseudo-normal data, anomalous activity that is not detected may be included in the training data and gradually absorbed into the model’s notion of normal behavior. User feedback on false and missed alerts, discussed in Section VI , is one way to reduce this risk. The capacity projection assumes that training jobs run sequentially and does not include data-upload time or bursts of simultaneous triggers. Finally, the alert-latency measurements were taken at different sites, with different cameras and traffic, from the earlier Ancilia measurement, and should not be read as a direct comparison.
blocks.zh: 限制: 本研究评价了系统效率,多站点操作,以及适应工作流程,但不评价更新模型是否比初始模型更准确地检测异常. 要衡量这一点,需要人工核实每个相机场景的异常标记,这不属于本作的范围. 由于再培训依赖于伪正常数据,未检测到的异常活动可能包含在培训数据中,并逐渐吸收到模型的正常行为概念中. 第六节讨论的用户对错误和错失警报的反馈是减少这种风险的一种方法。 能力预测假设培训工作是按顺序进行的,不包括数据上载时间或同时触发的突发事件。 最后,从早先的安西利亚测量数据来看,在不同地点进行了警报相关性测量,摄像头和流量也不同,因此不应被理解为直接比较。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This work presented YUTELA, an evolution of the Ancilia intelligent video surveillance system for multi-site AIoT deployment. YUTELA moves on-site processing from workstation-class servers to NVIDIA Jetson Thor edge devices and redesigns the multi-camera pipeline through camera redistribution, shared memory, reduced inter-stage data transfer, stage integration, and TensorRT acceleration. In controlled benchmarks with eight streams, TensorRT raised throughput from 14.17 to 29.94 FPS, and the optimized edge node exceeded the throughput of the workstation-based system in seven of nine workload settings, by up to 2.03 × 2.03\times at extreme density, although latency remained higher under lighter loads.
blocks.zh: 这部作品介绍了YUTELA,是Ancilia智能视频监视系统的演化,用于多地点的AIoT部署. YUTELA将现场处理从工作站级服务器移至NVIDIA Jetson 托尔边缘装置和重新设计多相机管道通过相机再分配,共享内存,减少阶段间数据传输,阶段集成,以及TensorRT加速. 在有8条溪流的可控基准中,TensorRT将吞吐量从14.17提高到29.94 FPS,优化的边节点在9个工作量环境的7个中超过了基于工作站系统的吞吐量,在极端密度下最高可达2.03×2.03\时,不过在较轻负荷下,耐力仍然较高.

blocks.en: Beyond edge inference, YUTELA maintains a separate anomaly model for each camera and retrains it on a centralized GPU server when enough recent pseudo-normal data have been collected, without placing the training workload on the embedded platform. A continuous 170-hour deployment at four public sites with 31 existing CCTV cameras showed that runtime load follows scene activity and input frame rate rather than camera count, that data-driven retraining frequency varied by about three times across sites, and that the 101 resulting training events occupied only about 6.6% of one GPU. Mean end-to-end alert latency ranged from 6.8 to 15.4 s depending on site traffic and anomaly type. Overall, YUTELA provides a practical and low-cost framework for combining efficient edge inference with camera-specific model adaptation in long-term, multi-site surveillance deployments.
blocks.zh: 在边缘推论之外,YUTELA为每台相机维持一个单独的异常模型,并在收集到足够近的伪正常数据后在中央GPU服务器上重新显示,而不将训练工作量放在嵌入式平台上. 连续在4个公共地点部署170小时,现有31台闭路电视摄像机,显示运行时间负荷遵循场景活动和输入帧率,而不是照相机计数,数据驱动的再培训频率各站点相差约3倍,由此产生的101次培训活动仅占一个GPU的6.6%左右. 根据现场流量和异常类型,平均端到端警报延迟度在6.8至15.4秒之间。 总的来说,YUTELA提供了一个实用和低成本的框架,在长期,多地点的监视部署中,将高效的边缘推论与针对镜头的模型改造结合起来.

blocks.en: Future work will measure the effect of adaptation on detection accuracy using manually verified evaluation data for each camera scene, and will extend YUTELA toward human-in-the-loop learning. In particular, user feedback from the alerting interface can be used to identify and label false-positive events, following the feedback-based learning strategy explored in [ 52 ] . Such feedback could improve pseudo-label quality and guide future model updates. Additional work will investigate larger deployment scales, scheduling of simultaneous retraining jobs on the global node, improved data selection strategies, and further reductions in communication and training overhead.
blocks.zh: 未来工作将利用人工核实的每个相机场景评价数据,衡量适应对探测准确性的影响,并将YUTELA扩展至人类即时学习。 特别是,在[52]中探索的基于反馈的学习策略之后,用户从提醒界面的反馈可用于识别和标注假阳性事件. 这种反馈可以提高伪标签质量,并指导今后的模型更新。 更多的工作将调查更大的部署规模、在全球节点同时安排再培训工作、改进数据选择战略以及进一步减少通信和培训间接费用。
